title: WellnessLiving vs Mindbody: 2026 Pricing Compared
description: WellnessLiving vs Mindbody: published plan prices, staff limits, marketplace and processing fees, and features, from both vendors' pricing pages.
body:
WellnessLiving and Mindbody both run class booking, memberships and payments for yoga, pilates, dance, fitness and martial arts studios. The biggest difference is how they price: Mindbody charges per location with unlimited users and publishes only its entry price, while WellnessLiving publishes three of its four plans but limits its cheapest plan to one staff member.

We checked both vendors' own pricing pages on November 1, 2026 (Mindbody pricing, WellnessLiving pricing). Anything they don't publish is marked unknown. We have not used either tool ourselves and we don't publish ratings.

{{table:wellnessliving,mindbody}}

Mindbody pricing

Mindbody's pricing page says plans start at $79/mo per location (North America and Asia) for Starter. Accelerate and Ultimate have no published price; every plan button says "Let's talk", and Mindbody suggests contacting sales about discounts. All three plans include unlimited users, point of sale and online payments, branded website widgets, a Customized Website and a listing on the Mindbody app. Mindbody says there is no onboarding fee on any plan.

  • Starter (from $79/mo per location): booking, integrated payments, website widgets, website, Mindbody app listing, basic reporting.
  • Accelerate (price unknown): adds advanced reporting, room and resource management, Pick-a-Spot and promo codes.
  • Ultimate (price unknown): adds automated email and text campaigns, a lead pipeline and the AI Concierge front desk. The branded app is an add-on on Accelerate and Ultimate.

WellnessLiving pricing

WellnessLiving lists monthly and annual prices (annual saves 10%):

  • Starter: $69/mo, or $62/mo billed annually. One staff member. Classes and appointments, client and staff apps, POS and card processing, email and SMS notifications, free data migration.
  • Business: $199/mo, or $179/mo annually. Unlimited staff, rewards, events, email and text marketing, lead management.
  • BusinessPro: $349/mo, or $314/mo annually. Adds the white-label client app.
  • Enterprise: call for price. Multi-location reporting, HQ account, cross-location visits.

On November 1, 2026 the page also showed a promotion of 80% off the first 2 months of Business ($39/mo) and BusinessPro ($69/mo), plus a "Free Website (Limited Time Offer)" on Starter. API access is $19/mo on every plan.

What it costs by team size

These are list prices only. Neither vendor publishes card processing rates on its pricing page, so your total will be higher.

  • Solo instructor: WellnessLiving Starter $69/mo ($62 annually) vs Mindbody Starter from $79/mo.
  • 2 or more staff: WellnessLiving needs Business at $199/mo ($179 annually) vs Mindbody Starter from $79/mo with unlimited users. Mindbody's own FAQ points this out.
  • Email/text marketing and lead management: WellnessLiving Business $199/mo vs Mindbody Ultimate (price not published).
  • Fully branded client app: WellnessLiving BusinessPro $349/mo vs Mindbody add-on on Accelerate or Ultimate (prices not published).

To run your own numbers, try our membership revenue calculator.

Marketplace and payment fees

Mindbody: listing on the Mindbody app is free, but when the app sends you a client who is new to your business, Mindbody charges 20% (capped at $30) on that first purchase. Later bookings carry no commission. With Mindbody Payments you pay a processing rate plus $0.10-$0.30 per transaction (North America and Asia), and you can use a third-party processor instead.

WellnessLiving: lists your business in its Explorer directory and integrates with Reserve with Google, ClassPass and Wellhub. Its pricing page says POS and card processing are included and claims savings of "over 20%" on processing, but it doesn't publish rates. Mindbody's pricing FAQ says WellnessLiving's help center lists extra gateway, maintenance and PCI fees. That's Mindbody's claim, and we haven't checked it against WellnessLiving's help center. Ask both vendors for a written processing quote.

Features that differ

  • Belt tracking: WellnessLiving lists Belt Progress Tracking. We didn't find it on Mindbody's pricing page, which matters for martial arts schools (see belt rank tracking software).
  • Check-in kiosk: WellnessLiving lists a client self check-in app and registration kiosk. Mindbody's pricing page doesn't mention a kiosk.
  • Spot and room booking: Mindbody Accelerate and Ultimate (Pick-a-Spot, rooms and resources). WellnessLiving lists Book-a-Spot asset reservations.
  • Family accounts: WellnessLiving lists family booking and relationship management.
  • Website: Mindbody includes a Customized Website from Starter. WellnessLiving has a limited-time free website on Starter, and its custom Presence website is an add-on.
  • AI front desk: Mindbody's AI Concierge is in Ultimate (add-on on Accelerate). WellnessLiving lists its CAASI AI Front Desk as an add-on.

Which to shortlist

If you're a solo instructor, or you want published prices for marketing and a branded app, WellnessLiving is easier to budget. If you have several part-time instructors and want marketplace exposure, Mindbody's unlimited users on Starter can cost less. Weigh that against the 20% first-purchase fee and the plan prices it doesn't publish. Martial arts schools that need belt tracking should also look at the best martial arts school software list. {{aff:wellnessliving|Visit WellnessLiving}} {{aff:mindbody|Visit Mindbody}}
